notes: A new image editor turns photos and scans into pages: crop, straighten a page photographed at an angle, convert it to black on white, and choose the paper size, margin and resolution. Delete, duplicate and move pages from the menu or by right-clicking a page. Reduce the size of a large PDF. Drag files onto the window, or paste a picture into Add Pages. Undoing back to the saved document no longer asks you to save again.
